def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    if np.any(valid):
        sqrt_remaining = np.sqrt(remaining[valid])
        perfect_square_closeness = -np.abs(sqrt_remaining - np.round(sqrt_remaining))
        priority_scores[valid] = perfect_square_closeness
    return priority_scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    if not np.any(valid):
        return np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    
    threshold = np.percentile(bins[valid], 75) - item
    priority_vals = -np.abs(remaining - threshold)
    priority_vals[~valid] = -np.inf
    return priority_vals
